scope: Compact consolidation of completed development measurements for assignments 6, 17, 21–31 and 34–36. This is not a complete agent-assignment ledger.

comparison_basis.before: Recipe immediately before each focused edit during this revision; a06 additionally records its baseline source commit.
comparison_basis.after: Recipe immediately after that focused edit, before the parent final VOLUME-calibration passes. Later edits to the same family have separate records.
comparison_basis.source_hashes: SHA-256 of the exact family/test source snapshot recorded by that review. Family hashes do not identify a complete executable or a final release commit.
comparison_basis.input_records: The input_record_sha256 map identifies the exact local review JSON used for this reduction; those temporary source JSON files are not packaged here.
comparison_basis.rounding: Most measurements are rounded to six decimals; sub-micro-dB differences retain scientific precision. Very low floating-point tail residuals show damping, not calibrated acoustic noise-floor performance.

limits: Signal, parameter and model measurements; no listening evaluation or acoustic/hardware-reference equivalence is claimed.
Before/after recipe comparisons are not comparisons with a downloaded qualified binary.

Focused category checks apply at their recorded development stage; final all-program calibration, integrated tests, exact native source SHA and downloadable-artifact qualification must be recorded separately.
Review counts overlap; do not sum family, category, inheritor and regression counts as distinct programs.

original_address_revoice.approach: Explicit named instrument recipes with authored finishes replace randomized preset generation; no new names or addresses are introduced.
original_address_revoice.status_in_this_record: Implementation and identity contract only; final integrated bank result belongs to the parent validation record.

reviews.change: Keyboard strike/body, tracked-partial, velocity and damping review; five representative onset comparisons from ten spectral captures.

method.spectrum: Mono average, Hann FFT; power above 350 Hz divided by power strictly between 230 and 290 Hz. This is a C4 band ratio, not a harmonic-identity or acoustic-similarity score.

changes.Sforzando Brass: Upper amplitude sustain .27→0; lower sustain .63→.42; faster independent filter/amplitude accent and lower supporting level.

method.held_range_window: The retained comparison records the held-range result but does not retain its exact window definition.

changes.Solo Violin: Rank II becomes a brief filtered noise onset (noise .95, attack .006 s, decay .24 s, sustain 0); mix .16, with body-level compensation and reduced continuous body noise.
changes.Solo Cello: Rank II becomes a brief filtered noise onset (noise .85, attack .010 s, decay .32 s, sustain 0); mix .14, with body-level compensation and reduced continuous body noise.
changes.Marcato Strings: Upper sustain .12→0, lower sustain .72→.52, faster accent and increased strike weighting.

reviews.changes: Recorder and Clarinet gain stronger short, filtered tongue/noise onsets and independent decay, preserving their pitched bodies and odd-harmonic distinction.
reviews.method: Unnormalized stereo rank captures at 48 kHz. Actual mix weights; isolated ranks reconstruct full audio with less than 1% RMS error. Onset 4–20 ms, attack 20–80 ms, sustain 300–500 ms. No acoustic-reference or perceptual assertion.

metric_units.onset: Mix-weighted detail/body dB during 4–20 ms; full six-case ranges appear below.

reviews.focused_validation: 14 Winds programs, all data/level/finite/circuit/headroom gates passed

method.metric: Range of stereo RMS windows, not a fitted sinusoidal amplitude.

focused_validation.role_protocol: All 14 reviewed registrations at 44100 Hz; notes 48/60/72, soft .30 / firm .85; exact PCM velocity independence and finite checks; isolated-rank reconstruction; percussion decay; stop ratios.

Mandolin.purpose: Reduce metronomic amplitude flutter while preserving independently decaying paired courses.

Nylon Pluck.purpose: Restore filtered string harmonics in a sine-dominated body while preserving the existing finger transient and decay.

method.harmonic_ratio: Power of harmonics 2–24 / fundamental, 0.1–0.3 s mono Hann FFT, 10log10 ratio. Fundamental is strongest bin within 8% of nominal pitch; each band has half-width max(7 Hz, .005 × harmonic frequency).
method.fast_envelope: 8–16 Hz order-3 Butterworth bandpass of 10 ms stereo RMS in dB sampled every 5 ms; RMS measured 0.2–2.2 s.
method.held_decay: Stereo RMS, 2.5–2.8 s relative to 0.1–0.3 s

changes.musical_change: 4 foot / second harmonic -> 2 foot / fourth harmonic
changes.name: Vibraphone

method.spectrum: Mono Hann FFT, 4× zero padding; harmonic power relative to fundamental.

reviews.limits: Two ranks and measured partial placement do not establish a complete vibraphone model or acoustic equivalence.

changes.name: Tremolo Pad
changes.description: Original sine SUB drives the circuit VCA at 3.8 Hz; existing BBD tremolo, filter, rank balance, detune and articulation retained.
changes.reason: BBD tremolo changes only its filtered wet branch with opposed stereo movement. Dominant dry low-mid body masked the named level pulse.

changes.name: Rain Pad
changes.description: Removed false Pure-CS-80 disabled-motion claim; describes active sample-and-hold filter and delayed upper entry.

reviews.method: 48000 Hz, MIDI 48/60/72, velocities .30/.85, pressure 0, held 7 seconds. Fit 3.8 Hz sine/cosine and linear trend to 20ms RMS envelope in dB during 2–6.8 seconds. Captures compare same engine/parameters except SUB VCA depth/rate.

method.held_swing: Max/min stereo RMS among non-overlapping 100 ms windows from 1.5 to 3.9 s; 20log10 ratio.

reviews.causal_evidence: Isolated ranks reconstruct the full signal below −142 dB relative RMS; body-only held-window range is about .10 dB, supporting shared-fundamental rank interference as the excessive slow-swing source.
preserved: Names, order, categories, descriptions and tags
Pressure-only silence and intentional Detuned/Noir/Ring/Trill behavior

reviews.changes: Tremolo Poly adds original sine SUB to VCA at 5.4 Hz, depth .20; BBD, pitch/filter controls, envelopes and then-current calibration retained. Description/tag updated.
reviews.method: 48 kHz, notes 48/60/72, velocities .30/.85, pressure 0, 7-second hold. 20 ms stereo RMS windows; dB-envelope fit over 2–6.8 s using intercept, linear trend and 5.4 Hz sine/cosine.

optional_long_hold_sweep.status: Stopped before final Modern-program check; excluded from completed 25-program standard-gate claim.

reviews.decision: Retain the 24 authored FX recipes: measured articulation and modulation roles justify no focused change.

pitch_method.frequency_estimate: Band-isolated analytic phase, 20ms smoothed; siren 1st-to-99th percentiles, alarm median settled pitch populations.

limits: Alarm transition-estimator overshoot is excluded from its settled interval. No unique acoustic target or listening claim.

reviews.changes: Removed obsolete PURE CS-80 software-layer-inert top comment. No preset sound, name, category, tag, description or insertion-order changed.
reviews.optional_longhold_status: Cancelled at source freeze; no completed-test claim.

method.fit: dB stereo RMS least-squares: intercept, centered time, quadratic time, sine and cosine at named rate
method.baseline: Original voicing; inactive SUB rate standardized to the target rate for the zero-VCA, zero-pressure control. No active pitch/filter route changes.

reviews.pressure_caveat: Tremolo Brass retains its existing 0.035 pressure-only pitch depth. Because the original SUB is shared, that pressure vibrato now uses 4.6 Hz instead of 5.1 Hz. Zero-pressure VCO/VCF depths remain zero.

negative_controls.Vibraphone: Prior octave upper registration; must fail same tracked fourth-mode criterion
negative_controls.Tremolo Organ, Pad, Poly: Disable only original SUB VCA depth, retaining BBD and all other voicing; must fail full-body rhythmic-motion criterion
negative_controls.Rubber Bass: Restore .08 body sustain; must fail held-note damping criterion
negative_controls.Picked Bass: Restore 3.1 s body decay; must fail body/onset persistence criterion
negative_controls.Nylon Pluck: Restore .56 sine / .34 VCF level / 920 Hz lowpass; must fail overtone/body presence criterion

reviews.change: Correct inherited sequence prose to match each final arpeggiator rate/direction/octave setting; fixed LFO periods and echo times are described separately.

example.name: Amber Sequences 157
example.before: Hold two to four notes around C3-C4 for eight notes per second across two octaves. A short octave accent and one-second filter cycle articulate the ascent. A warmer filter balance and a slightly longer body decay. Authored arpeggio pacing: 4.000000 notes per second.
example.after: An ascending arpeggio at 4 notes per second, using only the played octave. Hold two to four notes around C3-C4. A pulse body and short upper-octave accent follow a one-second filter cycle. A warmer filter balance and a slightly longer body decay.
